rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone overly focused on money and wealth.

example.english: They only care about money; they’re really materialistic.
example.traditional: 佢成日只睇錢，真係好拜金。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zi2 tai2 cin4 zan1 hai6 hou2 baai3 gam1

rows.note: Use this when stressing a person's concern with material possessions and material comforts rather than money alone.

example.english: They insist on a big balcony and fancy furnishings when choosing a flat; they’re really materialistic.
example.traditional: 佢揀屋一定要有大露台同靚裝修，真係好物質。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gaan2 uk1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jau5 daai6 lou6 toi1 tung4 leng3 zong1 sau1 zan1 hai6 hou2 mat6 zat1
